behaviors.description: Automatic confirmation must not suppress authentication interaction.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent token-gated runtime and authenticator observe real CLI request options; separate installs avoid cached payloads; a PTY answers basic credentials.
behaviors.expected: --noninteractive requests no-interaction, --assumeyes does not, both can install with a noninteractive token, and --assumeyes also permits basic credential prompts and exact deployment.

surface_assertions.rationale: Observed authenticator options and a real basic-auth exchange prove automatic confirmation does not suppress credentials.
The authenticator observes no-interaction while still supplying a valid token for an exact successful deployment.

mappings.rationale: Focused authentication distinction, not an additional broad lifecycle requirement.

notes: This development-branch interaction-policy change is not an authentication-bypass assertion. Older stable baselines may visibly fail it under the existing non-security failure policy; the auth.* security cases remain fatal.
